projectDescription: A GitHub Action that enables conditional execution of workflow steps and jobs based on the files modified by pull requests, feature branches, or pushed commits.
keyFeatures: Detect changed files in pull requests using GitHub REST API
Detect changed files in feature and long-lived branches using git diff
Define named filters with glob patterns using picomatch
Conditional step and job execution based on filter matches
List changed files in multiple formats (csv, json, shell, escape)
YAML anchor support for reusable path expressions
Filter by change type: added, modified, or deleted
Predicate quantifier control (some vs every) for complex filter logic
Monorepo support with matrix job configuration
publicApiSurface: input: filters (required) — YAML string or path to filter config file
input: token — GitHub access token (default: github.token)
input: base — Git reference to compare changes against
input: ref — Git reference from which changes are detected
input: list-files — Output format for matching file lists (none/csv/json/shell/escape)
input: initial-fetch-depth — Number of commits initially fetched from base branch
input: working-directory — Relative path where repo was checked out
output: <filter_name> — 'true'/'false' whether filter matched any changed file
output: <filter_name>_count — Count of files matching the filter
output: <filter_name>_files — List of files matching the filter (when list-files enabled)
output: changes — JSON array of all filter names that matched changed files
